# TrueLuvTake2

> A people-first community for adults 50+ ready for meaningful love. The people who love you most help find your person. No swiping, no algorithms.

TrueLuvTake2 was founded by Monique Alemán and serves adults aged 50 and over who are
looking for a serious relationship later in life. It is not a dating app and it is not
traditional matchmaking.

The model rests on two ideas. First, readiness: a member reflects on their own
self-knowledge before looking for anyone else, guided by a framework called the Five
Elements of Connection. Second, the Love Team: the member's adult children and closest
friends search on the member's behalf. The member never browses candidates themselves.
Introductions are made by people who have known them for decades and who attach their own
names to the introduction, which is what makes a fabricated person impossible to pass off
as real.

The community space where connection happens is called The Garden. It is members-only and
not yet open to the public.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.trueluvtake2.com/): What TrueLuvTake2 is and who it is for.
- [How It Works](https://www.trueluvtake2.com/how-it-works): The path a member follows, from readiness to introduction. Their Love Team searches on their behalf.
- [The Love Team](https://www.trueluvtake2.com/love-team): The adult children and closest friends who know a member's heart and search for their match.
- [The Five Elements of Connection](https://www.trueluvtake2.com/five-elements): The reflective framework for readiness and self-knowledge before looking for love later in life.
- [The Garden](https://www.trueluvtake2.com/the-garden): The members-only space where connection takes root. Coming soon.
- [Questions](https://www.trueluvtake2.com/faq): How it works, the Love Team, The Garden, membership, and finding love after 50, answered.

## About and joining

- [Meet Monique](https://www.trueluvtake2.com/about): Monique Alemán, founder. After decades in leadership she built a more intentional way to find love after 50.
- [Create Your Introduction](https://www.trueluvtake2.com/member-introduction-page): The free Introduction that begins membership.
- [Founding Membership](https://www.trueluvtake2.com/founding-member): The founding circle forming in Greater Boston.

## Media and partnerships

- [Media & Press](https://www.trueluvtake2.com/media): Reflections, articles, and the wider conversation about love later in life.
- [Partner With Us](https://www.trueluvtake2.com/partner-with-us): Collaboration, media, and affiliate opportunities.

## Terms used on this site

- **Members** are the people who join and are seeking a relationship. They are sometimes called Seekers. "Member" never refers to someone on a Love Team.
- **Love Team** is the correct name for the group searching on a member's behalf. It is never called an advisory circle.
- A member does not browse The Garden. Only the Love Team browses, on the member's behalf.
